sites.name: Bailey Canyon
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Pristine campground on the shores of Ruth Lake. Mixed conifer forest with some understory. 4 campsites along waterfront, others are in the shade of tall oaks, ponderosa and douglas fir trees. There is a 14-day limit for occupying a campground, and pets on leashes are permitted. Picnic tables, fire…
sites.reservations: No reservations. First come, first serve.

sites.name: Fir Cove Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Delightful campground, partly shaded under a canopy of oaks, maples, ponderosa pine and Douglas-fir trees. Short walk from campsites toRuth Lake waters edge.There is a 14-day limit for occupying a campground, and pets on leashes are permitted. Fir Cove trail is a 1/4 mile andoffers a short…
sites.reservations: No reservations. First come, first serve. Self register at entrance kiosk.

sites.name: Forest Glen Guard Station
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: This historic guard station offers you a unique stay in the oldest Forest Service building on the Shasta-Trinity National Forest. This charming two-story structure was built in 1916 under the direction of John T. Grey, District Ranger of the Mad River Ranger District on the old Trinity National…
sites.directions: From CA 36 turn south on Summer Home Road. The Historic Guard Station is on the right.
sites.restrictions: Fire Restrictions: Special fire restrictions limit the use of campfires, charcoal fires, smoking, and operation of most internal combustion engines at certain times of the year. Call the Hayfork Ranger Station at (530) 628-5227 to find out if any restrictions are in place. The use of portable…

sites.name: Forest Glen Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: This facility offers 15 camping units that can accommodate trailers up to 16 feet. There are vault toilets and drinking water and most sites have shade. The area provides opportunities for swimming, fishing and hiking. Please stay safe while near the Trinity River.
sites.directions: Take Hwy 3 south from Hayfork to Hwy 36. Travel 12 miles west.

sites.name: Hell Gate Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $6 per night
sites.waterText: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
sites.about: This campground offers 17 camping units that can accommodate trailers up to 16 feet. There is beach access, swimming, fishing, hiking and bird watching. Please stay safe while near the Trinity River.
sites.directions: Take Hwy 3 south from Hayfork to Hwy 36. Travel 11 miles west.

sites.name: Scott Flat Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.waterText: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
sites.about: This campground offers 10 campsites that can accommodate trailers up to 20 feet. Access to the facility is unpaved and there is no water system. The trailhead for the South Fork National Recreation Trail is located at this facility. Swimming, fishing, and hiking is available on the South Fork…
sites.directions: The campground is half a mile off Hwy 36. Take the Hell Gate turnoff to Forest Service road 1S25.

sites.name: Mad River Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Large campground with 40 campsitres available. Under the shaded canopy of douglas-fir, maples, and manzanita. Riverfront campsites offer trails down to the river. There is a 14-day limit for occupying a campground, and pets on leashes are permitted. 5minute drive to Ruth Lake.
sites.reservations: No reservations. First come, first serve. Self registration at entrance kiosk.
